RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 55

Lead with the qualifications gap, not the panel's composition. Your master's in educational leadership plus five years as deputy principal appears to outrank "courses" plus classroom experience — that comparison is the substance of any complaint, and it's strong. An all-male panel proves nothing by itself; plenty of such panels hire women. But as context, alongside an apparent qualification gap, it's legitimate background colour.

Your most actionable point is the unanswered request. In many jurisdictions an employer must give written reasons on request, and silence or vague reasons can shift the burden onto them to prove sex played no role. Send a dated follow-up citing your original request, then consult an equality body or union lawyer.
